scope: Validation profiles for the existing kernel; not a new registry or exhaustive live topology

dot_intake.next_proof: Existing mission/route IDs, authenticated actor and current authority readback

email_alert.next_proof: Existing trigger delivery, deduplication, liveness and failure receipt

research_completion.next_proof: Completion boundary calls the existing gate and verifies a separate reviewer

ct_receipt_ingestion.next_proof: Read-only ingestion of an existing RECONCILED receipt, with no broker call

stack_sync.next_proof: Exact approved per-domain mapping and canonical/required-destination readbacks

exception_resolution.next_proof: Existing exception record, owner, revisit trigger and verified resolution

reconciliation.next_proof: Actual version/hash conflict and recovery through the existing workflow

decision_memory.next_proof: Governed existing decision-to-outcome linkage, not automatic thesis promotion

promotion_requirements.canonical_bindings: Exact existing identities, per-domain authority and mappings, with current evidence
promotion_requirements.authenticated_context: Actor, reviewer and policy snapshots obtained by approved readers, not packet authors
promotion_requirements.atomic_revision_and_replay: Actual gateway compare-and-swap, uniqueness and concurrent duplicate tests
promotion_requirements.independent_review: Review by someone other than the implementation author; disagreements remain HOLD
promotion_requirements.negative_authority_tests: Unauthorized callers cannot bypass the actual write/completion boundary
promotion_requirements.source_promotion: Reviewed sanitized source and mandatory repository checks; no bypass
promotion_requirements.sandbox_end_to_end: A full authorized non-financial sandbox run with stored readbacks
promotion_requirements.recovery_and_resume: Interrupted write, partial mirror failure, restart and replay preserve identity
promotion_requirements.health_and_alerts: Existing scheduler/heartbeat liveness, delivery evidence and bounded exception alerting
promotion_requirements.rollback_and_live_approval: Verified rollback path and scoped deployment approval before live wiring
